ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Shokkweave Economy
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Campaign law for the sole-source ruling in design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_webwork.md section 6 ban 4: hyperweave IS shokkweave, renamed, and the Webwork is the only way to obtain it. Built for SHOKKWEAVE_SOLE_SOURCE_1, build-order step 1 (see design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/kits/shokkweave_sole_source_spec.md):
- Renames Hyperweave (defName UNCHANGED, Core shortHash 26103) to "shokkweave" with new flavor text. 617 RecipeDefs and every savegame reference keep working because the defName never moves. - Strips trader stocking via tradeability All -> Sellable: colonists can still sell it, but no trader (SingleDef, Tag, or Category route) ever generates or stocks it. TraderCanSell() gates Verse.RimWorld.StockGeneratorUtility.TryMakeForStockSingle directly, so this closes the KotOR guy762 SingleDef traders (Czerka, HuttGalleon) without touching their XML. - Strips it from the standard quest-reward pool (thingSetMakerTags: RewardStandardCore). - Belt-and-braces: also removes the ExoticMisc trade tag it is reached through. - Halves its stuff-commonality (0.1 -> 0.05) so rare offworld shokkweave gear survives as flavor at half the vanilla roll rate. - Gives the donor Wyyyschokk (mlie.starwarsanimalcollection) a small butcher yield of shokkweave: the silk is in the spider, not its hide (race.leatherDef untouched). - Web-cutting: RUT_Webwork_SilkKnot, a mineable silk vein scattered onto RUT_Webwork maps only, yields shokkweave when cut. - Nest raid: RUT_Webwork_Nest (MayRequire mlie.starwarsanimalcollection), a dormant lair guarded by a Wyyyschokk that wakes on approach; breaking it open drops a much larger shokkweave payout.
Out of scope here (see the item and spec): live trader-generation proof and the quest-reward roll pass (both need a quicktest map). Border creep-web: RUT_Webwork_Anchor/_Web/_Gutter (WEBWORK_KIT_BUILD_1) now carry a small killedLeavings shokkweave yield attached here (ShokkweaveCreepWebYield.xml) — the "yields" half of the ruling. The "spawns an emergent Shokk" half is NOT done: SHOKK_RSW_MOD_1's spawn-hook comp only fires on DestroyMode.Vanish, which combat-killing these Things never produces; a dedicated harvest job is still owed (see that patch file's own note).
WEBWORK_EGG_BLACKMARKET_BUILD_1: the Hutt Cartel egg black market. RUT_Caravan_HuttCartel_EggMarket (a rare Cartel caravan variant, appended to RUT_Jawa_HuttCartel's caravanTraderKinds) sells 1-3 RM_OllathrixEgg at a premium and buys contraband-tagged eggs at ordinary price; RM_OllathrixEgg's tradeability opens to All here only, campaign-side (the free tier keeps Sellable — nests only). See ShokkweaveEggBlackMarket.xml for the leak-check reasoning and the one engine limit found while building it (no native XML buy-side price premium exists on any RimWorld trader).
